rv.q: As a consequence, a familiar show shimmers with a new humanity and clarity that make theatergoers see it with virgin eyes.
The most disappointing aspect of Lapine's production is its sheer lack of visual appeal.

cn.t: This glorious revival dazzles with stellar lead performances and Sondheim's ravishing score, sung by a first-rate company that brings new life to this daring landmark musical.

vs.sum: The legendary former nightclub retains a distinctive atmosphere even in its theatrical configuration. However, comfort is among the worst on Broadway — the rear mezzanine is extremely steep with limited guardrails and tight legroom throughout both levels.

acc.note: No elevator to Mezzanine. 10 induction loops. 81 assistive listening devices. Orchestra wheelchair seating.
